caption: The drawing is a technical illustration of a card table made of mahogany, displayed in black ink on an off-white background. At the top, the "Top Plan" view shows a rectangular table with slightly chamfered corners and a circular marking in the center, along with measurements showing the table to be 36 inches wide and 12 1/2 inches deep, and another portion measuring 7 1/2 inches. To the right of this is a plan view of the base, depicting four diagonal legs labeled "Brass Legs" extending from a central circular hub. Below, the "Front Elevation" presents the table from the front, with dimensions noted as 25 3/4 inches wide and 29 1/4 inches high, detailing the tabletop thickness and the curved, ornate pedestal leg assembly. The "Side Elevation" beside it gives a profile view with corresponding decorative detailing on the central pedestal and curved legs, measuring 19 inches across the feet and 5 1/2 inches from the table’s edge to the pedestal. Both views include horizontal and vertical measurements for various sections. The bottom of the page is labeled "CARD TABLE MAHOGANY" and attributes authorship to Isidore Sovensky.
title: Card Table
